quote.text: All models are wrong, but some are useful.
quote.author: George E. P. Box, Robustness in the Strategy of Scientific Model Building, 1979

stories.headline: A $2,250 Buchardt outscores an $11,000 Børresen on the same Klippel rig
stories.dek: Erin Hardison measured both: preference 5.38 against 2.38, flatness ±1.6dB against ±5.1dB — and Dutch & Dutch raises its prices tomorrow, 1 November.

stories.headline: LAIKA’s Wildwood opens third on $12.3m from 2,817 screens
stories.dek: The studio’s best-reviewed film — 99 per cent from 154 critics, a Metascore of 88 with no negative notice — took a per-screen average of $4,356.

stories.headline: Perfumer’s Apprentice sells Dior’s palette in four-millilitre bottles at $6
stories.dek: Hedione costs six dollars for four millilitres and ninety-five for a kilogram — the same ladder as Iso E Super — and r/DIYfragrance grew 48.7 per cent in a year, to about 51,000.

stories.headline: Hackers drain $6.3bn from Binance hot wallets in about twenty minutes
stories.dek: The exchange blames a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop, has set aside more than $6.34bn of company funds, and says withdrawals restart in phases within about 34 hours.

stories.kicker: Singapore · A Record Inside A Falling Index
stories.headline: A five-room flat at SkyParc @ Dawson sold for S$1.818m, the first above S$1.8m
stories.dek: It is 1,195 square feet at S$1,522 per foot on the fortieth floor — in a quarter when the resale price index fell 0.1 per cent for the third time running.

stories.headline: OpenAI claims a proof that the Exponential Time Hypothesis is false
stories.dek: Anthropic published its own Lean-checked refutation on 27 October, credited to Claude — and five days on, the public record of independent checking is that an unnamed few got the files to compile.

stories.kicker: The Kit · The Price Nobody Guessed
stories.headline: Nikon prices the NIKKOR Z 120-300mm f/2.8 at $13,999.95
stories.dek: The lens ships in mid-November at 2,735g, 515g lighter than the F-mount version it replaces, with a 1.4× teleconverter built in on a switch.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Two Movements, One Watch
stories.headline: Louis Erard and Vianney Halter launch the Futur Antérieur at CHF 4,950
stories.dek: The riveted twin portholes run on two separate Sellita movements — one for the hours, one for the seconds — in 178 pieces per dial, announced 30 October.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The First Phone
stories.headline: Barzilay’s Philadelphia team ties a third of the first phone’s harm to one account
stories.dek: Of 3,486 children with no phone at twelve, 1,546 had one by thirteen — and three mediators account for about 80 per cent of the effect, published 30 September 2026.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · Price Restrictive, Quantity Expanding
stories.headline: The Fed, the ECB and the Bank of Japan all held rates
stories.dek: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00 per cent on 28 October ten votes to two, the ECB at 2.50 on the 29th, and the Bank of Japan at 1.25 on the 30th, eight to one.

stories.headline: Myers and Kokkinos link each extra MET to 16 per cent lower mortality
stories.dek: Published 6 October 2026, the ETHOS analysis puts adjusted ten-year mortality at 32.9 per cent in the unfit against 13.4 in the fit — and raises the model’s discrimination by 0.020.

stories.kicker: Departures · The Cabin And The Causeway
stories.headline: Singapore Airlines unveils four new cabins in November
stories.dek: The first refitted A350 returns in the first quarter of 2027, and all 41 aircraft are not due until the end of 2030 — about 27 per cent of a 153-aircraft fleet.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Two Deadlines In November
stories.headline: The National Gallery takes 30 per cent off Pop after Pop until 30 November
stories.dek: The Australian Open’s early-bird ground passes close at 12:59pm the same day — and marathon registration shuts tonight at 11:59.

stories.headline: Malaysia loaded nine million people’s welfare onto the MyKad chip
stories.dek: The finance ministry reported RM5.2bn of SARA transactions to September 2026 across 14,068 enrolled shops — and the credit expires on 31 December.
